en: Black-and-white interior view of a Catholic church photographed from the central aisle toward the main altar. The image shows rows of wooden pews on both sides, marble columns in the foreground, ribbed and painted vaulted ceilings, wall frescoes, and framed Stations of the Cross. At the far end stands a richly decorated baroque/neo‑baroque high altar with statues and candlesticks, flanked by side altars and a hanging chandelier. Light from tall, narrow arched windows creates diagonal shadows across the floor.
